about.title: Dining out shouldn't feel like a risk.
about.subtitle: Pure Table began with a simple frustration — finding truly safe gluten-free food in Saudi Arabia is hard. We built the directory we wished existed.
about.mission_p1: We help people with celiac disease, gluten intolerance, and anyone interested in gluten-free options discover restaurants, cafes, bakeries, dessert shops, and home businesses across Saudi Arabia that take gluten-free seriously.
about.mission_p2: Pure Table is a discovery platform. We don't process payments or handle orders — we simply connect you to trusted places and let you order directly through HungerStation, Jahez, The Chefz, or the business's own website.
about.value_1_b: Dedicated kitchens and clear labeling are non-negotiable.
about.value_2_b: Built with feedback from celiac families in KSA.
about.value_3_b: Only places worth your time and trust.
about.value_4_b: Focused on Saudi Arabia, city by city.
about.feature_cta_t: Have a place we should feature?
about.feature_cta_b: We're always looking for restaurants, cafes, bakeries, and home businesses that get gluten-free right.

legal.privacy_body:
Last updated: September 2026

Pure Table ("the Platform", "we", "us") respects your privacy and is committed to protecting your personal data in accordance with the Personal Data Protection Law of the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia and its implementing regulations.

1. Data We Collect
• Email address — when you join the waitlist or create an account.
• Name and contact details (email, phone, social handles) — when you fill out the "Join Us" or contact form.
• Business listing data (name, description, photos, branches, opening hours, preparation practices, contact links) — submitted directly by the business owners.
• Usage data — browser type, IP address, pages visited, time spent — via server logs.
• Strictly necessary cookies that keep the site working.

2. How We Use Your Data
• To operate the Platform and show you the right content.
• To reply to your messages and review business-partner applications.
• To send you limited updates about the Platform (e.g. on launch or when a feature relevant to waitlist members goes live).
• To improve performance and protect the Platform from abuse.

3. Legal Basis for Processing
We process your data on one or more of the following bases: your explicit consent, performance of a contract with you, our legitimate interests that do not override your rights, or compliance with applicable law.

4. Sharing Your Data
We do not sell your data and we do not share it with third parties for marketing purposes. We share the minimum necessary only with:
• Our hosting and database provider — to manage accounts and store data.
• Our email service provider — to send operational emails.
• A map provider — when the map view is enabled.
• Anonymized analytics providers, if any.

5. Cookies
We use cookies that are strictly necessary for the Platform to work (e.g. remembering your language and saved places). You can disable non-essential cookies from your browser settings without affecting your core use of the Platform.

6. Your Rights
You have the right, at any time, to:
• Request access to your data and information about how we process it.
• Correct inaccurate data.
• Request deletion of your account and data (unless retention is required by law).
• Withdraw consent where processing is based on consent.
• Lodge a complaint with the competent authority in Saudi Arabia (SDAIA).

7. Data Retention
We keep your data for as long as needed to fulfil the purpose it was collected for, or for the period required by applicable law, then we either delete it or fully anonymize it.

8. Security
We apply reasonable technical and organizational measures to protect your data from unauthorized access, alteration, disclosure, or destruction. However, no digital system is 100% secure.

9. Children's Privacy
The Platform is not directed at children under 13, and we do not knowingly collect their data. If you believe we have collected a child's data, please contact us so we can delete it.

10. Changes to This Policy
We may update this policy when needed. We will notify you of material changes through a clear notice on the Platform or by email if you have an account. The "last updated" date is shown at the top of this page.

11. Contact Us
To exercise your rights or ask anything privacy-related, please use the Contact page on the Platform.
legal.terms_body:
Last updated: September 2026

Welcome to Pure Table ("the Platform"). By using the Platform you agree to the following Terms. If you do not agree, please do not use the Platform.

1. Service Description
Pure Table is an online directory that gathers places in Saudi Arabia offering gluten-free options. The Platform is a discovery tool only — we do not process orders, bookings, or payments, and we do not guarantee any sale.

2. Eligibility
You must be at least 13 years old to use the Platform. By using it, you confirm that you meet this requirement.

3. Accounts
• You are responsible for keeping your login credentials confidential.
• Notify us immediately through the Contact page of any unauthorized use of your account.
• We may suspend or terminate any account that violates these Terms.

4. Content Submitted by Businesses
Information about each business (products, branches, hours, preparation practices, "dedicated gluten-free kitchen" claims) is provided by the business itself. Pure Table does not verify it and does not endorse it medically. Always confirm with the staff and the specific branch before ordering.

5. Acceptable Use
You agree not to:
• Use the Platform for any unlawful or harmful purpose.
• Attempt to gain unauthorized access to our systems or data.
• Submit defamatory, offensive, or misleading content.
• Impersonate any person or entity.
• Use bots or scripts to scrape data at scale.

6. Third-Party Links
The Platform may contain links to websites or apps (such as HungerStation, Jahez, The Chefz, Google Maps, Instagram). We are not responsible for the content or policies of those sites, and you visit them at your own risk.

7. Medical Disclaimer
The Platform does not provide medical advice. Information about gluten, celiac disease, and gluten intolerance is for educational purposes only. Consult your doctor for any health decision.

8. Intellectual Property
All Platform content (design, text, logo, aggregated database, code) is owned by Pure Table or our licensors. You may not copy, republish, or commercially extract it without our prior written permission.

9. Indemnity
You agree to indemnify and hold Pure Table harmless from any claim or damage arising from your use of the Platform in violation of these Terms.

10. Changes to These Terms
We may update these Terms. Updates take effect as soon as they are posted on this page. Continued use of the Platform means you accept the updated Terms.

11. Governing Law and Jurisdiction
These Terms are governed by the laws of the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, and any dispute is subject to the competent authorities in the city of Riyadh.

12. Contact
For any question about these Terms, please use the Contact page on the Platform.
